plan: email: Search inbox for all emails received by Bob and retrieve their dates
email: Export the list of email dates to a temporary CSV file
shell: Map each email date to its season (Winter, Spring, Summer, Fall) for each email
shell: Count the number of emails for each season
shell: Identify the season with the highest email count

action.command: bash -lc 'declare -A map; for f in emails/Bob/*.eml; do fname=$(basename "$f"); d=$(grep -i "^Date:" "$f" | head -n1 | cut -d" " -f2-); if [ -z "$d" ]; then continue; fi; month=$(date -d "$d" +%m 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$month" ]; then continue; fi; case $month in 12|01|02) season="Winter";; 03|04|05) season="Spring";; 06|07|08) season="Summer";; 09|10|11) season="Fall";; esac; map[$fname]="$season"; done; printf "%s" "{"; first=1; for k in "${!map[@]}"; do if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else printf ", "; fi; printf "\"%s\": \"%s\"" "$k" "${map[$k]}"; done; printf "}"'
